violated_contract: A provider rejection caused by an intentional zero-audio teardown must not be treated as a live-session failure. Counting this expected close as terminal failure triggers unnecessary failover, pollutes terminal SLI metrics, and can feed provider health state despite no user speech being lost.
canonical_prevention: Track audio actually sent to the provider and classify its no-audio rejection as a clean teardown once finishing has begun. Keep active-session no-audio deaths visible, and test both lifecycle phases plus the end-of-audio behavior for streams that sent audio.
